observations: Whole independent image selected before scene code: ivory round head, face turned right in three-quarter view, narrow continuous torso, separated capsule arms/legs, small mitten hands and elongated feet against charcoal.
Owner screenshots guide dark sparse stickman staging; their running/sofa actions and wording are not requested in this film.
assumptions: Finite stress design: heightScale=1.12, boxScale=1, tableHeight=152. Same whole reference and unchanged original action/tempo followup as ordinary carrier.
This parameter package tests exactly eight existing registered designs through one CarrierDesign implementation. It makes no claim about arbitrary sizes or automatic first-pass success.

Ordinary accepted cf289 base, all previous movies and negative probes are preserved. MODEL and FINAL selected controls plus dense/event geometry and native parity supplement owner playback; pending playback remains pending.

actionBeats.action: Bend with separated elbows/knees, reach and close both grips
Accept load while box is still on floor
Lift through legs; bring box toward body
Lower and land box on actual bench
Withdraw clear of bench, then lower arms beside thighs

criteria.description: Continuous torso and distinct whole arm/leg chains in approach, squat, carrying and withdrawal. Intended depth overlap may remain; no fused forearm/shin silhouette.

Stand close to the fixed floor box before grip. Low reach may open the elbows naturally. Both actual C-palms, their curls and contact with the box remain readable; never approve from anchor equality alone.
Two grips close before load/lift; box stays close during walking with alternate passing feet, fixed support contacts and coherent load response. Bench supports the actual box before hands release.
Both hands and forearms clear the actual bench corner/top through withdrawal and settle. Preserve small and large payload shapes and the quiet endpoint.
Same strict IK, bone lengths, real contour/contact/forearm-shin and release relations for exactly the eight declared designs; geometry pass is not appearance approval.
